definitions.short: a juniper (from its nudity of situation)
definitions.full: H6176. aroer I. עֲרוֺעֵר noun [masculine] probably a tree or bush; juniper ? (Arabic juniper (or cypress ? see Lane), so Tristr NHB 358 Rob BR ii. 124 ; on formative see Lag BN 162 Ba NB 160 ); — בַּמִּדְבָּר עֲרוֺעֵר Jer 48:6 , + 17:6 , where read probably בָּעֲרָבָה עֲרֹעֵר (for עַרְעָר ᵑ0 ; > Gf and others conversely, read עַרְעָר 48:6 ).
